info.title: Ellie local coordinator API
info.description: Contracts for the routes implemented by the Ellie V1 HTTPS coordinator. Bearer identity roles and local capability/app/site allowlists are runtime authorization checks; this document describes them but cannot enforce them.

servers.description: Default loopback coordinator; paired nodes may use the configured trusted-LAN origin.

post.summary: Pair a node with a single-use invitation

get.description: Controller bearer identity required. The response contains only fixed status and recovery reason values, plus the canonical origin when ready.

post.description: Controller bearer identity required. The response deliberately contains a single-use code; callers must not log it or place it in a URL.

get.summary: List public browser client identities and grants
get.description: Controller bearer identity required. Credential verifiers are never returned.

post.description: Controller bearer identity required. Revocation is persisted before success.
Controller bearer identity required. The response binds a single-use invitation to the actual native listener origin and leaf certificate pin.

get.summary: List public native-app identities and grants
get.description: Controller bearer identity required. Credential verifiers are never returned.

post.description: Controller bearer identity required. Revocation is persisted before success.

get.description: The controller sees all nodes; a node bearer identity sees only itself.

post.description: Node bearer identity required. `capabilities` is the optional V1 legacy execution field; `executionCapabilities` takes precedence when both are present. Compute capability requires telemetry.

post.summary: Refresh node liveness and optional compute state
post.description: Node bearer identity required and the node must already be registered. Compute capability requires telemetry.

get.description: Node bearer identity required and the node must already be registered.

200.description: A desktop job, inference job, or null after the long-poll interval.

post.summary: Report the matching in-flight job result
post.description: Node bearer identity required. The ID must match that node’s delivered job.

post.summary: Commit that a delivered job is starting
post.description: Node bearer identity required. The response prevents execution when cancellation won the delivery/start race.

post.summary: Run bounded inference on one eligible independent worker
post.description: Controller bearer identity required. Worker selection and local admission are semantic runtime checks.

post.summary: Route and deliver a deterministic desktop command
post.description: A controller can target any visible node. A node identity can target only itself. Required operation capability and the coordinator and node app/site allowlists are semantic runtime checks.

200.description: Command outcome, including unsupported deterministic input as `ok: false`.

post.summary: Request cancellation of queued or running work
post.description: Cancellation does not undo native side effects that already started.

200.description: Current job metadata after the request.

BadRequest.description: Request rejected. Check input, pairing, and granted capabilities.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required. Pair this node first.

Forbidden.description: Identity role, node ownership, origin, or revocation rejected the request.

Conflict.description: Current node or job state rejected the request.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The coordinator service is temporarily unavailable.

url.description: An absolute HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.
